text:
maya: Quick note — onboarding sampleapp users keep causing duplicate downstream jobs by hammering the "replay" button. Backend logs show bursts of 429s then fast client retries.

leo: Which SDK/version and call type? streaming vs sync?

maya: Node sample v1.5.4, sync generate only. Users click while the previous request is still inflight.

trina: Two obvious fixes: (1) add UI debounce + disable replay while inflight, (2) idempotency helper in node SDK for non-streaming calls. Also safer retry defaults with jitter.

leo: Agreed. SDK parity gap: python has a replay-guard helper we landed last quarter; node never got the helper. I'll pick the node PR for a `withIdempotency(key)` convenience and default retry -> exponential backoff + full jitter.

maya: UX quick wins: 400ms debounce on the button, persist last fingerprint in sessionStorage (TTL 4min), and show a toast when a duplicate is suppressed.

trina: Also flagging a gateway quirk: some 429s come back with Retry-After in ms (60000) and others in seconds (60). Clients parsing as seconds end up waiting the wrong amount. Infra should normalize but SDKs must parse defensively.

infra-bot: INF-2101 created: normalize Retry-After units on gateway and add telemetry for suspicious values.

leo: For SDK parsing: treat numeric Retry-After > 3600 as ms -> divide by 1000; if > 86400 after that, fallback to exp backoff with jitter. Also if header missing, fallback to jittered backoff.

maya: For idempotency key guidance in onboarding: make keys tenant-scoped to avoid collisions. Example snippet: 
```
const key = base64url(sha256(tenantId + '|' + userId + '|' + prompt).slice(0,12));
client.withIdempotency(key).generate(...)
```
Server keep TTL = 5m.

trina: Tests: unit test streaming requests never set idempotency header; integration test fires 50 concurrent identical requests and asserts single webhook invocation. Also a chaos test alternating Retry-After units.

leo: I'll add the node change + tests. Trina, can you update sampleapp UI and README?

maya: Will do. Also add a tiny migration note in onboarding: "If you copied the sample verbatim, regenerate idempotency keys to include your tenant id."

qa-bot: Scheduled smoke test: replay-debounce -> staging.

maya: Thanks — aim to have node PR + sampleapp update in staging by Friday. Ping here for review or if infra finds anything surprising. :thumbsup:
